notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken Forest.
description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing a nontoken Forest, which is a creature due to Ambush Commander.
When the Forest dies, Yedora triggers, returning the Forest from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
When the Forest enters the battlefield as a creature due to Ambush Commander, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
